Location

📍 Arrival: PMI Cour Reception
Avenue de Cour 107, Lausanne
Open in Maps

Badge collection: Please bring your ID/passport to collect your visitor badge. Badges will be prepared in advance to keep the process quick.

⚠️ Important: All attendees must check in at Cour reception. Badges are not available at the Rhodanie reception — if you arrive there by mistake, you will need to walk up to Cour reception.

☕  Where to Use IQOS & VEEV

Need a place to enjoy your break?

  • External terrace 9.C by the Reception
  • IQOS Lounge — 9th floor
  • IQOS Lounge — 8th floor
  • IQOS Lounge — 6th floor, under the escalator
Around Lausanne
Make the most of your time in the city.
🧀 Where to Eat (and Enjoy Fondue!)

Pinte Besson

Rue de l'Ale 4, 1003 Lausanne
📞 +41 21 312 59 69
Website

Lausanne's oldest restaurant (est. 1780), famous for its traditional fondue in a cozy, wood-paneled setting.

Café du Grütli

Rue de la Mercerie 4, 1003 Lausanne
📞 +41 21 312 94 93
Website

A charming spot for Swiss specialties and fondue, with a warm, rustic ambiance.

Brasserie de Montbenon

Allée Ernest Ansermet 3, 1003 Lausanne
📞 +41 21 320 40 30
Website

Elegant brasserie with lake views and a refined menu using local ingredients.

The Lacustre

Quai Jean-Pascal Delamuraz 1, 1006 Lausanne
📞 +41 21 617 42 00
Website

Lakeside bar-restaurant with wood-fired pizzas and cocktails. Great for sunset drinks.

Eat Me Restaurant & Cocktail Bar

Rue Pépinet 3, 1003 Lausanne
📞 +41 21 311 76 59
Website

Trendy fusion restaurant offering small plates from around the world and creative cocktails.

🍹 Where to Enjoy a Cocktail

Le Vestibule

Rue Cité-Devant 4, 1005 Lausanne
Speakeasy-style bar near the cathedral with inventive cocktails.

JAJA

Rue de la Barre 1, 1005 Lausanne
Glamorous and lively, perfect for dancing and daiquiris.

Lausanne Cocktail Club

Rue du Grand-Pont 12, 1003 Lausanne
Stylish and modern, known for mixology and ambiance.

Eat Me Restaurant & Cocktail Bar

Same address as restaurant above
Great for a pre-dinner drink or late-night cocktail.

🍫🧀 Where to Buy Chocolate & Cheese

Blondel Chocolatier

Rue de Bourg 5, 1003 Lausanne
Website
Open Mon–Fri 09:30–18:30, Sat 09:30–18:00

Artisanal chocolates made on-site since 1850.

Läderach Chocolatier Suisse

Centre Commercial Métropole, Rue des Terreaux 25, 1003 Lausanne
Website
Open Mon–Fri 08:30–19:00, Sat 08:00–18:00

Swiss chocolate with a modern twist.

Manor Food Hall

Rue Pichard 3, 1003 Lausanne
Website
Open Mon–Fri 09:00–19:00, Sat 09:00–18:00

Gourmet supermarket with a wide selection of Swiss cheese and chocolate.

🖼 What to See & Do

Lavaux Vineyards

A UNESCO World Heritage site just outside Lausanne. Enjoy scenic walks or wine tastings with stunning lake views. Accessible by train or boat.

Olympic Museum

Quai d'Ouchy 1, 1006 Lausanne
Website

Explore the history and spirit of the Olympic Games in an interactive and inspiring setting.

Ouchy Promenade

Lakeside walk with gardens, cafés, and views of the Alps. Great for relaxing or catching a boat cruise.

Lausanne Old Town

Discover cobbled streets, the Gothic cathedral, and local markets.

⚠️ Shops in Lausanne close early, usually by 18:30 or 19:00 on weekdays, even earlier on Saturdays, and most are closed on Sundays. Plan your shopping smart!
